brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief - Key developments across Global Maritime Governance, Carbon Markets, Space Technology, Urban Informal Sector, and AI Ethics.

articles.title: India-Nordic Smart Governance and Maritime Security Framework
articles.summary: India and the Nordic nations signed a comprehensive pact to enhance Arctic research, critical subsea infrastructure protection, and the sustainable blue economy.
prelims: Focuses on Sustainable Blue Economy and green shipping corridors in the Arctic and Indian Ocean.
Establishes a joint mechanism for critical subsea infrastructure protection against seabed vulnerabilities.
Complements India's Deep Ocean Mission and the SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) policy.
articles.mains: Use as a concrete example of middle-power diplomacy, Arctic geopolitics, and multilateral maritime cooperation in International Relations (GS2).

articles.title: Rollout of Phase II Compliance Framework under Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS)
articles.source: Indian Express / Bureau of Energy Efficiency
articles.summary: India transitions from voluntary offset mechanisms to a mandatory compliance carbon market covering energy-intensive industrial sectors.
prelims: Administered jointly by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) and the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC).
Introduces GHG Emission Intensity Reduction targets for obligated entities across steel, cement, and petrochemicals.
Directly supports India's updated Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement.
articles.mains: Illustrates market-based instruments for climate change mitigation, industrial decarbonization, and environmental economics (GS3).

articles.title: ISRO Successfully Executes Gaganyaan High-Altitude Orbital Return Test
articles.summary: ISRO verified critical atmospheric re-entry systems and parachute deceleration sequences for the upcoming crewed spaceflight mission.
prelims: Validated Apex Cover Separation and Apex Drogue Parachute deployment in upper atmospheric conditions.
Tested the indigenous Thermal Protection System (TPS) during simulated high-velocity re-entry.
Utilized an upgraded, human-rated LVM3 launch platform for experimental trajectory testing.
articles.mains: Highlights technological self-reliance, aerospace capability enhancement, and high-value scientific R&D spillovers in Science & Technology (GS3).

articles.title: Expansion of DAY-NULM 2.0 for Climate-Resilient Urban Livelihoods
articles.source: Business Standard / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
articles.summary: The enhanced Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission focuses on gig economy integration and social security for climate-vulnerable urban workers.
prelims: Aims at formalizing and upskilling informal and gig workers across Tier-2 and Tier-3 urban centers.
Integrates micro-credit access under PM SVANidhi with digital credit-scoring systems.
Provides targeted socio-economic safety nets for informal households exposed to urban heat island and flooding risks.
articles.mains: Relevant for analytical questions on urbanization dynamics, informal sector vulnerability, poverty alleviation, and social justice (GS1 / GS2).

articles.title: MeitY Releases National Ethical Framework for AI in Public Service Delivery
articles.summary: New guidelines mandate algorithmic transparency, auditability, and mandatory human-in-the-loop oversight for automated public welfare systems.
prelims: Mandates Algorithmic Impact Assessments (AIA) prior to deploying AI tools in social welfare distribution.
Establishes an oversight framework under the National AI Ethics Committee within MeitY.
Focuses on eliminating algorithmic bias, ensuring data privacy, and safeguarding citizen rights.
articles.mains: Serves as an ideal case study for ethical governance, administrative accountability, technological ethics, and public service integrity (GS4 Ethics).
